description: Defines the rx::RenderStateCache class, which manages caching of Direct3D 11 render state objects such as blend, rasterizer, depth stencil, and sampler states. Includes hash specializations for state keys and methods to retrieve or create states, with cache size limits.

classes.name: RenderStateCache
classes.description: A cache for Direct3D 11 render state objects, including blend, rasterizer, depth stencil, and sampler states, with cache size limits and cache management methods.

methods.name: GetBlendStateKey
methods.description: Generates a blend state key based on context, framebuffer, and blend state.

methods.name: getBlendState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a blend state object based on the key.

methods.name: getRasterizerState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a rasterizer state object based on raster state and scissor enable flag.

methods.name: getDepthStencilState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a depth stencil state object based on depth stencil state.

methods.name: getSamplerState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a sampler state object based on sampler state.
